crew.overview: The true story of the Mauritanian Mohamedou Ould Slahi, who was held at the U.S military's Guantanamo Bay detention center without charges for over a decade and sought help from a defense attorney for his release.
crew.title: The Mauritanian

details.biography: Ryan Heller is an American film producer. He is currently the Executive Vice President at Topic Studios, of film and documentary. Heller previously worked at Starz, as the Senior Director of Acquisitions and Distribution for the company's feature film department. Heller has produced films such as "The Climb", "The Nowhere Inn", "Bring Your Own Brigade", "The Mauritanian", and "Spencer". Heller has also produced the television series "Love Fraud", "100 Foot Wave", and "Nuclear Family".
details.name: Ryan Heller
